name: Volume Rendering with 3D Textures and Ray Marching
aliases: GPU Ray Casting for DICOM Volumes
WebGL Volume Raymarching with Lighting and Surface Occlusion
definition: A volume rendering system that visualizes medical imaging data by loading volumetric data into 3D textures and rendering it using a ray marching shader pipeline in WebGPU.
summary: This GPU method renders volumetric data by marching rays through 3D textures, preserving internal details without polygonal meshes.
